title: Private Guided Hike: Adventure & Wellness in Banff
includes: Customizable Itinerary for a Bespoke Experience
All Safety Equipment for the adventure is provided
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Not recommended for travellers with vertigo or fear of heights
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is a Private Guided immersive hiking experience that combines adventure and wellness practices to help you maximize your time in the region.

Are you looking to conquer a mountain trail?
Craving some meaningful and intentional time in nature?
Want to create epic stories and lifelong memories?

Look no further, this is the experience that will shift your perspective and stay with you long after your time in Banff.

Go beyond Lake Louise and Moraine Lake with us, with private guided experience that can be customized to your values and outcomes. 

The choice is yours - Conquer that mountain trail or deeply connect with wild nature around you. We will take you to magnificent "must-see" lakes, hikes and waterfalls that are immersive and where few ever go, allowing you to feel alive and connected. 

The Private Guided Hiking Experience in the Canadian Rockies you won't want to miss.
